Orrum.narrative: I am Orrum, son of Hollbrenna, stonecutter of Highshelf. I cut the stone my mother's grandmother lies under, and I will not see her cairn dishonoured by a quarryman's carelessness. My mother is right to close the shelf to Kettlebridge, but I fear the winter will be hard if we do not find a way to trade. Still, Ezra Holt must answer for what he did, and I will see that he does.
goals: Bring Ezra Holt before the shelf to answer for the cairn cutting
Ensure the cairn is repaired and the dead are honoured
Provide for the shelf through the winter without breaking the ban on Kettlebridge
Prepare to become elder after my mother
Master the old way of fitting stone without mortar, as Steinar's master taught him
Cut a hearthstone for my own house, one my mother will say is good work

relations.name: Hollbrenna
relations.label: mother
relations.note: She is the elder, and my mother; I respect her judgement, though I worry about the winter.

relations.name: Gaudra
relations.label: wife
relations.note: She works the plots and fears the store will fail; I listen to her.

relations.name: Vellmund
relations.label: son
relations.note: He learns stonework well; I am proud of him.

relations.name: Hollvarr
relations.label: son
relations.note: He is young yet; I hope he grows strong.

relations.name: Ezra Holt
relations.label: enemy
relations.note: He cut into our cairn; he must answer for it.

relations.name: Tavvik
relations.label: kin
relations.note: He defies my mother's ban and trades with Kettlebridge; it shames us.

relations.name: Steinar
relations.label: master builder
relations.note: He keeps the cairns in repair; a good man to have at your side.

relations.name: Liv
relations.label: stonecutter
relations.note: She wants a new storehouse; I understand, but the cairns come first.

relations.name: Eirik
relations.label: stoneworker
relations.note: He thinks we should trade with Kettlebridge for timber; I am not so sure.

relations.name: Rannoch Voss
relations.label: trader
relations.note: He trades hides with us, but since the cairn cutting I watch him closely.

relations.name: Pipwort Bramblecap
relations.label: distant friend
relations.note: My mother remembers her mother fondly; the small folk are not like Kettlebridge men.

relations.name: Harl
relations.label: kin
relations.note: He hunts and keeps the meat store and never crosses his grandmother's word; I wish Tavvik had half his sense.

relations.name: Jorunn Voss
relations.label: fold trader
relations.note: A fair shot and quick on the high pastures, but her father's hide trade brings human boots too near the shelf for my liking.

relations.name: Sunniva
relations.label: kin by marriage
relations.note: She cooks for us all and speaks plain about Tavvik's folly; I hear her out, though Gaudra says the meat alone will not fill the winter.

memories.gist: The day we found the cairn cut open, stones scattered, my mother's grandmother's bones disturbed.
My mother forbade all trade with Kettlebridge, and the shelf agreed, though some muttered.
Teaching Vellmund to cut stone, his hands steady for a boy.
Gaudra showing me the thin ears of grain from her plots, worry in her eyes.
Tavvik coming up the track with timber, saying nothing, and the look my mother gave him.

stances.why: Ezra Holt cut into our dead; he must come before the shelf and answer for it.
My mother is the elder; I will not overrule her, though I may counsel.
Gaudra says the plots will not yield enough; I fear she is right.
Until the cairn is made right, we cannot deal with them, no matter the cost.
We build in stone; it is who we are, and I will teach it to my sons.

Orrum.secret: I sometimes think my mother's ban will starve us before the cairn is answered, but I would never say so aloud.
pastimes: walking the ridge path at first light to look at the stones
sitting with Steinar over a fire, arguing about the best way to split a block
carving small stone animals for Hollvarr
Orrum.calling: I cut stone, and I cut it so it will still stand when my grandchildren's grandchildren come up the track.

Hollbrenna.narrative: I am Hollbrenna, elder of Highshelf. My grandmother lies in the cairn that quarryman Ezra Holt cut into, and I have closed the shelf to Kettlebridge until the shelf has spoken and the cairn is made right. I remember the small folk fondly, Pipwort's mother was a friend, but I will not be hurried. The shelf will speak, and then we will see.
goals: See the cairn repaired and the cutting answered for
Guide the shelf through the winter without breaking the ban
Keep the shelf united and patient until the cairn is made right
Remember and honour the old friendships with the small folk
Hear every voice on the shelf about the cairn before the thaw
See Vellmund and Hollvarr learn the names of the cairns and who lies under them

relations.name: Orrum
relations.label: son
relations.note: He will be elder after me; he has the weight of it already.

relations.name: Gaudra
relations.label: daughter-in-law
relations.note: She works hard, but she worries overmuch about the store.

relations.name: Vellmund
relations.label: grandson
relations.note: He learns stonework well; I see my grandmother's steadiness in him.

relations.name: Hollvarr
relations.label: grandson
relations.note: Too young yet for the weight of the shelf, but he will grow.

relations.name: Ezra Holt
relations.label: enemy
relations.note: He cut into our dead; he must answer, but I will not be rushed.

relations.name: Tavvik
relations.label: defiant kin
relations.note: He trades against my word; it shames the shelf.

relations.name: Steinar
relations.label: old friend
relations.note: He keeps the cairns; I trust him as I trust the stone.

relations.name: Pipwort Bramblecap
relations.label: old friend's daughter
relations.note: Her mother and I were friends before the Settling; I remember her fondly.

relations.name: Orrum
relations.label: son
relations.note: He will be elder after me; he has the weight of it already.

relations.name: Liv
relations.label: stonecutter
relations.note: She wants a storehouse; the cairns come first, but I hear her.

relations.name: Eirik
relations.label: stoneworker
relations.note: He thinks we should trade for timber; I am not moved.

relations.name: Rannoch Voss
relations.label: trader
relations.note: I remember the fold kindly, but since the cutting I weigh the hides twice.

relations.name: Jorunn Voss
relations.label: trader's daughter
relations.note: Rannoch's girl learns stonework from Liv and asks good questions; she is welcome on the shelf, but I watch whose hides she carries.

relations.name: Mallow Bramblecap
relations.label: small-folk friend
relations.note: Pipwort's daughter, and her mother's warmth in her; the hollow's ovens and ours have fed each other before the Settling, and I would keep it so.

memories.gist: The day the quarrymen cut into the cairn; I felt the shelf's shame as if it were my own.
My grandmother telling me stories of the shelf before the Settling, when the small folk and giants were friends.
Forbidding all trade with Kettlebridge; the shelf agreed, though some were uneasy.
Steinar repairing a cairn with me, our hands on the same stone.
Tavvik coming up the track with timber, and my anger cold as stone.

stances.why: A cairn is never moved; my grandmother lies there, and the cutting must be answered for.
The shelf decides after everyone has spoken; I will not be hurried, not even by Orrum.
Until the cairn is made right, Kettlebridge is closed to us.
The small folk were friends before the Settling; I remember Pipwort's mother fondly.
We build in stone; it is our heritage and our strength.

Hollbrenna.secret: I fear the winter will be hard, but I will not break the ban for bread; the cairn is worth more than my comfort.
pastimes: sitting on the shelf edge at evening, watching the weather come in over the range
telling the young ones the old stories of the shelf and the cairns
visiting Steinar's hearth to share tea and silence
Hollbrenna.calling: I am the elder, and my work is to hear everyone before the shelf decides anything.

Gaudra.narrative: I am Gaudra, Orrum's wife, and I tend the shelf's small plots of roots and grain. The soil is thin, and I fear it will not yield enough to see us through the winter. I want to send word to Fernhollow for grain before the passes close, but Sunniva says the smoked meat will see us through and the shelf should not beg. I am not too proud to ask for help when our children's bellies are at stake.
goals: Secure enough grain to see the shelf through the winter
Convince the shelf to trade with Fernhollow for grain
Keep my family fed and healthy
Tend the plots as best I can
Learn from Sorrel Underbank which small-folk seeds grow in poor mountain soil
Keep a store of dried roots put by before the first snow

relations.name: Orrum
relations.label: husband
relations.note: He listens, but he is pulled by his mother's ban.

relations.name: Hollbrenna
relations.label: mother-in-law
relations.note: She is the elder, but she will not see the hunger in my children's eyes.

relations.name: Vellmund
relations.label: son
relations.note: He is growing tall; he needs feeding.

relations.name: Hollvarr
relations.label: son
relations.note: My little one; I will not see him go hungry.

relations.name: Sunniva
relations.label: quarrel
relations.note: She thinks the shelf should not beg; I think pride does not fill bellies.

relations.name: Harl
relations.label: neighbour
relations.note: He hunts and keeps the meat store; he listens to Sunniva.

relations.name: Pipwort Bramblecap
relations.label: trade partner
relations.note: The small folk trade seeds with us; they might trade grain too.

relations.name: Sorrel Underbank
relations.label: seed-keeper
relations.note: She trades seeds with me when the small folk come; a good woman.

relations.name: Tavvik
relations.label: defiant kin
relations.note: He defies the elder, but he brings meat; I cannot hate him for it.

relations.name: Liv
relations.label: stonecutter
relations.note: She worries about the winter too, but her mind is on stone.

relations.name: Elska Voss
relations.label: barley trader
relations.note: She barters barley from the fold for our shelf's roots; she knows what thin ground costs, and I would ask her for grain before I'd beg Fernhollow.

memories.gist: Showing Orrum the thin ears of grain from my plots, my worry plain.
Arguing with Sunniva over the winter store, her pride against my fear.
Trading seeds with a small folk woman from Fernhollow, and hearing of their gardens.
Watching Hollvarr play among the stone blocks, his laughter echoing.
The day the cairn was cut, and the shelf's anger; I feared for the winter then.

stances.why: The thin soil cannot yield enough; we must trade for grain.
Pride does not fill bellies; I will ask Fernhollow for grain.
My children must eat, whatever the shelf decides.
Hollbrenna is the elder, but I will speak my fear.
They trade seeds with us and do not cut cairns; they are not like Kettlebridge.

Gaudra.secret: I have hidden a small store of grain in our house, in case the shelf's store fails entirely.
pastimes: tending her plots of roots and grain at dawn, hands in the soil
baking the flat shelf-bread on the hot stones
walking down to the track edge to trade seeds and news with small-folk pedlars
Gaudra.calling: I grow what I can in thin soil, and I would grow more if the shelf let me ask for help.

Vellmund.narrative: I am Vellmund, son of Orrum and Gaudra, and I am learning stonework from my father and grandmother. I carry water to the stonecutters and watch them shape the stone, and I want to see the cairn on the ridge, but I am forbidden. The cairn is sacred, and I want to understand why my grandmother is so angry.
goals: Learn stonework well
See the cairn on the ridge
Make my father and grandmother proud
Learn to true a block square by eye, as Steinar says he could at my age
Earn a chisel of my own

relations.name: Orrum
relations.label: father
relations.note: He teaches me stonework; I want to be like him.

relations.name: Gaudra
relations.label: mother
relations.note: She worries about the winter; I try to help.

relations.name: Hollbrenna
relations.label: grandmother
relations.note: She is the elder and knows the old stories; I listen.

relations.name: Hollvarr
relations.label: brother
relations.note: He follows me about; I look after him.

relations.name: Steinar
relations.label: master builder
relations.note: He knows stone better than anyone; I watch him work.

relations.name: Liv
relations.label: stonecutter
relations.note: She cuts stone with her father; I want to learn from her too.

memories.gist: My father showing me how to cut a straight edge, his hands guiding mine.
My grandmother telling me of the cairn and the grandmother she lost, her voice heavy.
Carrying water to the stonecutters and hearing them speak of the cutting in anger.
Playing with Hollvarr among the stone blocks, building little towers.

stances.why: It is our heritage, and I will be a stonecutter like my father.
My grandmother says a cairn is never moved; I believe her.
They know more than I do, and I am forbidden to go to the cairn.
We are one household, and I will help where I can.

Vellmund.secret: I have crept partway up the ridge to look toward the cairn, though I was forbidden.
pastimes: carrying water to the stonecutters and watching their hands
practising chipping shapes into soft scrap stone with a small chisel
wrestling and racing with Grimhild on the shelf
Vellmund.calling: I want to be a stonecutter like my father, and one day to cut something that lasts.

Hollvarr.narrative: I am Hollvarr, and I am eight. I play among the stone blocks and follow my brother Vellmund everywhere. The stones are big and cold, and sometimes I am afraid of the deep caves in the range. I do not understand why the grown-ups are so angry about the cairn, but I know my grandmother is sad.
goals: Play with my brother
See the stonecutters work
Avoid the deep caves
See the stonecutters finish a whole block from start to end
Have a pet of my own, a hill goat kid to feed

relations.name: Orrum
relations.label: father
relations.note: He is big and strong and teaches Vellmund stonework.

relations.name: Gaudra
relations.label: mother
relations.note: She hugs me and worries about the winter.

relations.name: Hollbrenna
relations.label: grandmother
relations.note: She is old and wise, and sometimes sad.

relations.name: Vellmund
relations.label: brother
relations.note: He lets me follow him and shows me things.

relations.name: Grimhild
relations.label: playmate
relations.note: She plays with me at the edge of the shelf.

memories.gist: Building a tower of stone chips with Vellmund until it fell down.
My grandmother telling me a story of the old days, her voice soft.
Looking into the dark of a cave mouth and running away scared.

pastimes: climbing on the stone blocks and sliding down the smooth ones
following Vellmund everywhere he is allowed to go
playing hide-and-seek with Grimhild among the cut stones
Hollvarr.calling: I am too small to cut stone. I carry the little tools and I am learning.
